freshness.notes: Postal identities, type, geography and timezone may use different dated references. Reads do not refresh upstream data.

uncertainty.null: Unsupported or unavailable facts remain null.
uncertainty.coverage: Country coverage and field availability: https://parseapi.com/postal#coverage. Coverage varies by country.

billing.account_state: unknown; account allowances, quota and accepted terms are not checked

access.effective_access_status: not_checked; account access, key fences and quotas apply

retry.guidance: A successful response with unknown facts is a completed result, not a reason to retry. Respect explicit unavailable errors and retry guidance.

determines: Covered place identity, native/display names, source place type, geography and timezone where available
Optional reviewed grain, immediate parent and partial direct place relationships
Filtered paged City collections; optional paid Deep population, observation date, elevation and area
Great-circle distance between recorded centers; optional admitted official romanization
does_not_determine: Complete worldwide place or field coverage
Road distance, routing or travel time
Official romanization from ASCII folding
A fresh upstream acquisition on every request
City execution through /task or /preflight; those admission policies are separate
required_context: Store the own city_ ID from a selected response; do not substitute an upstream identifier or a display name
Keep country and state codes together; state names are not valid state filters
Choose grain=municipality when selecting a reviewed whole municipality; type retains source terminology
Use ambiguity=error for exact selection that requires a caller choice; 409 candidates are bounded public identities
Keep all filters, limit, language and shape options unchanged when reusing next_cursor

response.resource: format=resource: object=city and the complete ordinary City fields, including own id
response.collection: format=list: object=list, data and next_cursor; keep request filters unchanged for continuation
response.legacy: Default lookup, typeahead and named-nearby envelopes remain compatible
response.geojson: format=geojson: Feature or FeatureCollection; null geometry when coordinates are unavailable

freshness.actual_age_status: Fact observation dates where available; an import date is not an observation date
freshness.notes: Population dates and place boundaries may differ between records. Coverage and limits are documented on the City lander and reference.

uncertainty.null: Unsupported, missing or conflicting facts remain null. Null population is not zero. Unknown grain and parent remain null.
uncertainty.coverage: Partial curated reference. A catalog or index must pass its activation gate; readiness503 is not an empty match.
uncertainty.romanization: romanized=true returns admitted official aliases only; missing or conflicting aliases return null.
uncertainty.relationships: coverage=partial; no parent or relation is inferred from a matching name or distance.
uncertainty.distance: method=great_circle; known zero is preserved, unknown coordinates yield null.

errors.400: Invalid controls or cursor from another query/catalog; restart pagination when the edition changes
errors.409: ambiguous_city under ambiguity=error; bounded safe candidates without Deep
errors.404: City ID or name is not present in the serving catalog
errors.503: Required catalog or admitted spelling index unavailable

billing.account_state: unknown; access, allowance and accepted account terms still apply
billing.conditional_reads: A 304 response does not waive ordinary request billing

access.effective_access_status: not_checked; key fences, account access and quotas still apply

retry.guidance: Do not retry a409 automatically. Select a bounded candidate. Correct invalid filters and restart rejected cursors. Respect Retry-After; empty matches are not an outage.
